get.summary: Get all phases related to a specific olympiad
get.description: Retrieves all phases that are associated with any area of the specified olympiad. When an olympiad is created, it generates a specified number of phases that are automatically related to each area through the olympiad_area_phases table.

200.description: List of phases for the specified olympiad retrieved successfully

phases.description: List of phases associated with the olympiad

areas_count.description: Number of areas this phase is associated with in this olympiad

404.description: Olympiad not found or no phases found

get.summary: Get all level-grade associations from an olympiad area
get.description: Retrieves all level-grade relationships attached to the specified olympiad area, including their associated level and grade data.

200.description: List of level-grade relationships retrieved successfully

post.summary: Assign a level and its grades to an olympiad area with smart level reuse
post.description: Assigns grades to a level within an olympiad area. Reuses existing levels with the same name or creates new ones. Automatically assigns default score cuts to all phases if the olympiad has a default_score_cut configured. Prevents duplicate grade assignments within the same olympiad area.

parameters.name: areaId
parameters.description: ID of the area within the olympiad

requestBody.description: Level name and grade IDs to assign

level_name.description: Name of the level. If a level with this name already exists, it will be reused instead of creating a new one.

grade_ids.description: Array of grade IDs to assign to this level. Each grade can only be assigned to one level per olympiad area.

level.description: The level with its assigned grades

level_was_created.description: Indicates if a new level was created (true) or an existing one was reused (false)

default_score_cut_assignments.description: Information about automatic score cut assignments (only present if olympiad has default_score_cut)

error.example: The following grades are already assigned to levels in this olympiad area: Grade ID 3 (Level: Nivel Secundario)
A database constraint or connection error occurred. Please check your data and try again.

get.summary: Get all score cuts for an olympiad area
get.description: Retrieves all phases of the specified olympiad area, along with their associated level-grades and score cuts.

200.description: List of score cuts retrieved successfully

post.summary: Assign score cut to all grades of a level for a specific phase
post.description: Assigns the same score cut (minimum passing score) to ALL grades within a specific level for a given phase in an olympiad area. This simplified approach applies the score cut to every grade in the level at once, making it much easier to manage score cuts by educational level rather than individual grades.

parameters.name: areaId
parameters.description: ID of the area within the olympiad

requestBody.description: Phase, level and score cut configuration

phase_id.description: ID of the phase where the score cut will be applied

level_id.description: ID of the level. Score cut will be applied to ALL grades within this level.

score_cut.description: Minimum score required to pass this phase (0-100)

200.description: Score cuts assigned successfully to all grades in the level

data.description: The olympiad area phase with its score cut assignments

olympiad_area_phase_level_grades.description: All level-grade relationships with their assigned score cuts

affected_grades_count.description: Number of grades affected by this score cut assignment

created_count.description: Number of new score cut records created

updated_count.description: Number of existing score cut records updated

error.example: The level 'Booster' (ID: 3) has no grade associations in the area 'Matemáticas' for olympiad 'Olimpiada 2025'. Please assign grades to this level first.

error.example: A database error occurred while assigning score cuts. Please try again.
